prompt:
You are planning a production data-delivery pipeline. Find a schedule with the globally minimum makespan. Time starts at 0, starts/durations are nonnegative integer minutes, jobs are non-preemptive. Each listed resource has capacity 1. A job holds ALL its resources for its full duration. Every predecessor must finish before the job starts. Intervals are half-open [start,end), so back-to-back jobs can share a boundary. There are no other constraints. Return ONLY JSON {"makespan": integer, "starts": {"A": integer, ..., "H": integer}} with all 8 jobs exactly once. Do not return code or explanatory prose. Job specification:
{"A": {"after": [], "duration": 4, "resources": ["ingest", "operator"]}, "B": {"after": [], "duration": 3, "resources": ["ingest"]}, "C": {"after": ["A"], "duration": 5, "resources": ["compute"]}, "D": {"after": ["A"], "duration": 2, "resources": ["compute", "operator"]}, "E": {"after": ["B"], "duration": 4, "resources": ["transfer", "operator"]}, "F": {"after": ["C", "E"], "duration": 3, "resources": ["compute"]}, "G": {"after": ["D"], "duration": 2, "resources": ["ingest", "operator"]}, "H": {"after": ["F", "G"], "duration": 3, "resources": ["transfer"]}}
